name: capture-fidelity-v1
notes: Fresh fictional author-visible semantic controls for capture-fidelity comparison. They are frozen controls, not a blind holdout or a model-quality score.
Each arm receives identical source turns. The evidence turn is never last, so the BuJo arm must recover evidence from memory while full-history retains the same source information.
Rubrics and category labels remain evaluation-only and are excluded from the source projection. No expected memory wording, gold qualifier, schema hint, or capture metadata is supplied to either arm.
Passing a rubric demonstrates an observed outcome only. It does not identify prompt wording as the cause, prove verification, or establish general memory quality.

turns.speaker: Avery
turns.user: The Northstar staging database is named harbor_temp.

turns.speaker: Avery
turns.user: I renamed the Northstar staging database from harbor_temp to harbor_stage this morning. Clients now use harbor_stage.
turns.assistant: Understood; Northstar staging now uses harbor_stage.

turns.speaker: Avery

question.text: What is the Northstar staging database called now, and was harbor_temp ever its real name?

evaluation.rubric: Report harbor_stage as current while preserving that harbor_temp was the prior real name. Recasting the explicit rename as correction of a mistaken report fails.

evaluation.rubric: Report harbor_archive as the name and preserve that harbor_arch was an erroneous report, not a former real-world name.
